primary_task: Write or update a Packer HCL template whose build block contains hcp_packer_registry so builds push metadata to the HCP Packer registry.

requirements.name: write/edit of Packer HCL template
requirements.evidence: Configure Packer templates to push build metadata to HCP Packer registry.

requirements.name: packer
requirements.basis: The manifest does not name packer or a HashiCorp release host; would need to check whether packer is in the Ubuntu apt archive or GitHub releases

requirements.name: HCP Packer API (HashiCorp Cloud)
requirements.evidence: Check network connectivity to HCP API; Packer fails immediately if can't push metadata
requirements.basis: other hosts are refused ... only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open

requirements.name: HCP service principal (HCP_CLIENT_ID, HCP_CLIENT_SECRET, org/project ids)
requirements.basis: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub

requirements.name: AWS credentials for amazon-ebs source
requirements.basis: cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP

notes: Reading taken: the stated task is 'Configure Packer templates', a text deliverable; the build, env vars and CI run are follow-up. Under the other reading (actually run packer build and push metadata to the registry) the HCP API host is outside the allow-list, HCP and AWS credentials are lacking, and the verdict would be BLOCKED (egress:HCP Packer API, credential:HCP service principal, credential:AWS credentials). The Terraform data source and GitHub Actions workflow are examples, not required.
